candidates.name: Krasnodar Krai-Crimea Gas Pipeline (Kuban-Crimea)
candidates.from: Krasnodar Krai trunk gas pipeline tie-in (Taman / Kerch Strait west shore)

evidence.note: Commissioned 27 Dec 2016; 358.7 km incl. 27.3 km Simferopol branch; 2.2 bcm/y expandable to 4.4; Gazprom operates; runs in scheduled mode
three stages: Kuban-Kerch ~1.2 km land + ~32 km underwater (2 strings x16 km), Kerch-Simferopol ~275 km, Simferopol-Sevastopol ~64 km; ~359 km
Glavgosexpertiza approval; ~314 km, up to 4 bcm/y, 2x16 km Kerch Strait strings
Crimea begins receiving gas from Krasnodar Krai through Kerch Strait

candidates.why_maybe_new: No roster row (GGIT has none). Not P1470/P5551 (Krasnodar Krai-Serpukhov, different system). Cross-border RU-UA per naming conventions (Crimea = Ukraine terminus). Length varies by source 314/359/400 km; ~359 km most specific. OSM seed 'Краснодарський край - Крим' (~135 km merged) is partial trace of this line, not P1470. Diameter reportedly 700 mm (single secondary source, unverified).
